description: This satellite imagery displays a large, elongated dark blue-black water body, which is consistent with a natural lake or a reservoir, surrounded by predominantly brownish-tan land featuring some scattered greenish-brown vegetation patches. Two clusters of reddish-pink pixels indicate human settlements; one larger cluster is situated in the upper left of the image, and a smaller one is located closer to the center, adjacent to a bend in the water body. The main water body's irregular shoreline is delineated by an overlaid light blue-green boundary line. Additionally, a distinct red line traces a path or feature across the brownish land area to the east of the water body. The surrounding terrain appears undulating. This image serves as a visual example for the classification of "Natural lakes" in land cover mapping programmes, such as the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) CORINE Land Cover (CLC+) programme, encompassing features like lakes, dams, barrages, and hydropower station reservoirs.
